name: Session authentication
summary: Hardened password authentication with verification, recovery, and replay-safe rotating sessions.

environmentVariables.name: REQUIRE_VERIFIED_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Gates sign-in and protected requests on verification; required in production.

environmentVariables.name: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TTL_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of a single-use verification token.

environmentVariables.name: PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of a single-use password reset token.

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Selects memory or Redis rate-limit storage; production requires Redis.

environmentVariables.name: REDIS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Redis connection URL used by the shared authentication limiter.

environmentVariables.name: IDENTITY_NOTIFIER_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Selects memory, SMTP, or an application-injected notification adapter.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_WEB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public application origin used to construct verification and reset links.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SMTP provider hostname required when SMTP delivery is selected.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: SMTP username configured together with the password.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SMTP credential required when authenticated SMTP is selected.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_FROM_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Sender address required when SMTP delivery is selected.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_SECURITY
environmentVariables.description: Selects STARTTLS, implicit TLS, or transport security delegated to the network.
